editorial:
Imagine having a brother who just knows how to push every single one of your buttons. That is exactly what you get with Simo and Emad. These two teenagers spend most of their time fighting and trying to one-up each other, which feels like a normal part of growing up. However, the vibe quickly shifts from funny sibling rivalry to something much darker. You will feel the tension build as their small arguments spiral into a dangerous game that puts their entire family's safety and future on the line. It starts off feeling like a slice-of-life drama but turns into a high-stakes ride that keeps you guessing.

What really works here is the acting, as the chemistry between the brothers feels totally real. The pacing is quick, though some of the plot twists might feel a bit sudden. If you enjoy stories about family conflict and unexpected danger, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a heavy realization that the brothers' fighting went too far. After a series of bad choices, the final scenes show the fallout of their actions on their parents. The twist reveals that their competition caused a permanent rift that cannot be fixed with a simple apology. They eventually find a way to stop the violence, but they have to live with the guilt of how they almost destroyed their home.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gritty family dramas and stories about sibling rivalry.
